**Simplifying one-hot outputs**

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module ticket_machine #(
    parameter ON  = 1'b1,
    parameter OFF = 1'b0
) (
    input  clk, clear, ten, twenty,
    output reg ready, dispense, return_sig, bill
);

    // Reachable-state one-hot representation, established by clear.
    reg s_ready, s_disp, s_return;
    reg s_bill10, s_bill20, s_bill30;

    wire take10;
    wire take20;
    wire hold_amount;

    assign take10      = ten;
    assign take20      = ~ten & twenty;
    assign hold_amount = ~ten & ~twenty;

    // Direct one-hot transition equations avoid full-state comparisons.
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (clear) begin
            s_ready  <= 1'b1;
            s_disp   <= 1'b0;
            s_return <= 1'b0;
            s_bill10 <= 1'b0;
            s_bill20 <= 1'b0;
            s_bill30 <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            s_ready  <= s_disp | s_return | (s_ready & hold_amount);
            s_disp   <= (s_bill20 & take20) | (s_bill30 & take10);
            s_return <= s_bill30 & take20;
            s_bill10 <= (s_ready & take10) | (s_bill10 & hold_amount);
            s_bill20 <= (s_ready & take20) | (s_bill10 & take10)
                      | (s_bill20 & hold_amount);
            s_bill30 <= (s_bill10 & take20) | (s_bill20 & take10)
                      | (s_bill30 & hold_amount);
        end
    end

    always @* begin
        ready      = s_ready ? ON : OFF;
        dispense   = s_disp ? ON : OFF;
        return_sig = s_return ? ON : OFF;
        bill       = (s_bill10 | s_bill20 | s_bill30) ? ON : OFF;
    end

endmodule
",

  "expected_timing_gain": "The rewrite is intended to reduce state-decode and transition-selection depth, especially on register-to-register paths. No timing improvement is measured or guaranteed; synthesis and STA must confirm strictly better setup WNS and non-regressing TNS at the fixed settings.",

Explicit one-hot implementation may use more flops than a synthesis-selected compact encoding, although it avoids full-state output decoding. Mapped area must be checked against the 278.01664000000005 um2 cap.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, ports, parameter declarations and defaults, single positive-edge clock, synchronous clear priority, and Moore output latency. When ten and twenty are both asserted, ten wins. DISP and RTN return to RDY on the next non-clear edge regardless of inputs. The required startup clear establishes a valid one-hot state; all transitions and arbitrary later clear assertions preserve that invariant. No additional startup or input assumptions are introduced. Illegal internal encodings before the required startup reset are not given the original default-state recovery behavior; equivalence is required over the specified post-reset behavior with default ON=1 and OFF=0."
}
